blocks.html: Calling the attention of new and versed professionals! Robinsons Malls is proud to announce the opening of a series of PRC mobile services where professionals can now file and renew their licenses easily and hassle-free. In cooperation with the Professional Regulation Commission, professionals can now opt to claim their licenses in the selected Robinsons Malls nearest them. Avoid the long queues and the long hours in the traffic and avail of the convenience that Robinsons Malls is offering to the public. Numerous outlets of the PRC mobile services are spread across different Robinsons Malls for easy access to the public. In Metro Manila, professionals can file and renew their licenses in Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Galleria and Robinsons Nova Market on Apr. 24-28, May 15,-19, June 5-9, July 10-14, Sept. 4-7 & Oct. 2-6. In Robinsons Cainta, on the other hand, the PRC mobile kiosks begin its operations on Aug. 7 & 8. For those residing in North Luzon, the PRC mobile services are open in Robinsons Santiago starting on April 6, 7, 20 & 21 and on May 11, 12, 29 & 30. Professionals from South Luzon can file and renew their licenses in the following malls namely Robinsons Place Antipolo on May 29 & 30 and on Oct. 17 &18; Robinsons Palawan on June 26 & 29, Aug. 15 & 17, and Sept. 26 & 29; Robinsons Place General Trias on July 3 & 5; Robinsons Place Lipa on Aug. 3 & 4 and on Oct. 2.; Robinsons Sta. Rosa on Aug. 21 & 22; Robinsons Los Baños on Oct. 19 & 20; Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on Nov. 23 & 24 and Sumit Ridge Tagaytay on July 5 & 6 and on Oct. 3 & 4.
